Name: Junk Mail
Author: Taskmaster2
Description:
[i]Junk Mail[/i] adds a playful twist to your mailbox by delivering randomized letters that range from silly to surprising. Instead of only receiving the usual in‑game notices, you’ll occasionally find odd notes, quirky advertisements, or unexpected correspondence that keep your daily routine fresh. Every letter is written to feel like it belongs in Stardew Valley’s world, blending humor, immersion, and a touch of unpredictability.

Whether you’re looking for a laugh, a bit of extra flavor, or just something new to check when the mail flag goes up, [i]Junk Mail[/i] makes Pelican Town feel a little more alive.

Now a colorized envelope will give you a hint at what letter group might be waiting for you.  For example, letters from the Temple of Yoba, will display gold envelope.
